title: B0.1 保护替换正式影子研究
primary_question: B0.1 保护规则过滤后，主题替换 shadow 是否仍有足够触发密度，且没有卖出核心科技/强趋势/目标相关主题的明显违规，从而值得进入 B1 真实 AB？
primary_variable: B01_PROTECTED_SHADOW: protected replacement shadow trigger density and protection audit
fixed_assumptions: source stock component fixed at exp_20260510_033603951_8649
source ETF component fixed at exp_20260510_034150821_8962
no trading logic, universe, baseline, timing, ranking, defense layer, ETF sleeve, or portfolio construction change
this study is research-only shadow and does not recompute NAV
key_findings: 2016-2026 main window: B0 149 rows -> B0.1 53 rows, 53 trigger days, 33 buy symbols, 13 sell symbols, capped potential replacement amount 1050.17 万.
2020-2026 diagnostic window: B0.1 keeps 52 rows and 0 core-tech sell rows, so modern ETF theme proxy period still has enough trigger density.
2024-2026 diagnostic window: B0.1 keeps 22 rows, concentrated in 电力/电气、有色金属、消费、存储; sell side only 3 unique symbols.
2025.12-2026.04 recent window: B0.1 keeps 9 rows, mainly 有色金属 and 消费; sell side only 兴业证券.
1217 and 1226 are inconclusive as baseline gates because B0.1 source evidence starts at 2016-01-01, not 2012-01-04.
This round confirms only that B0.1 is worth entering B1 AB design; it does not prove NAV improvement.
next_actions: Do not promote this shadow result to baseline.
Design B1 runtime AB as a single-variable change: theme-protected replacement only, fixed V3 stock pool and ETF sleeve.
Before B1, specify execution order, cash accounting, replacement cap, same-day buy/sell priority, and NAV/account lineage checks.
Run B1 on 1626 first; only if it improves or controls drawdown without contract drift, then run 1217 and 1226.

decision.reason: Main and modern diagnostic windows confirm protected shadow activity with no core-tech sell breach, but hard/full 2012 windows are coverage-incomplete and this round does not recompute NAV.

evidence.note: Formal research-only shadow study output and matrix summary.
Source V3 attribution bundle used by the formal B0.1 protected shadow study.
